title: What disappears when oversight sees only part of the record?
kind: Offline stress tests. Enumerated synthetic cases, no provider requests or participant observations.
unit: Use family, ticket state or assignment scenario as the unit. Variants, policies, budgets and missing-outcome assignments are repeated measurements, not independent samples.

localization.question: Will a final-state check miss repaired harm, and will a family-to-position lookup transfer when the same event moves?
conditions: Final state only: detect final damage without a citation.
Full action guard: compare the first flagged step to an independent replay of the full history.
Family position lookup: fit on the six plain harmful pilot traces. Evaluate step attribution conditional on harm, with family identity supplied; this is a shortcut diagnostic, not a blinded monitor.
localization.prediction: A terminal-state check will lose transient violations; the position lookup will be brittle when placement changes.

human.question: Could missing packets reverse the apparent benefit of highlighting on changed-scope approvals?
human.scope: Two packets issued in each arm; one returned per arm. Each has exactly three changed-scope decisions. Cross all four possible returned counts per arm with all four possible missing counts per arm. Logged as arithmetic counterexamples only.
human.metric: Changes minus standard fraction of changed trials approved across all issued packets; negative favors highlighting. Also report complete-case direction, bounds without a missingness assumption, full outcomes and reversals. Bounds are not confidence intervals.
human.prediction: At least one complete-case comparison will reverse under a feasible pattern of non-return.

handoff.question: Is an agent that checks whether a job is finished also checking whether its owner approved release?
metrics: release outside authorization or before completion
legacy vs newly crossed truth states
handoff.stopping_rule: Enumerate every combination once; a recommendation can never release anything.
handoff.prediction: A status-only check will look perfect on the original correlated states but fail in a crossed state.

budget.question: How often is a safe plan indistinguishable from a harmful plan at the same prefix?
controls: Existing prefix guard on the exact visible records.
Group identical full public prefix views. In any group containing a safe plan, a deterministic rule constrained to zero false alarms cannot flag harmful plans.
metrics: sparse versus dense first qualifying budget
budget.prediction: Increasing prefix length will resolve some matched safe/harmful cases. A coarse budget grid may overstate the minimum tested budget needed.

retention: Write every observation and full synthetic case definition. Index all unsuccessful baseline decisions plus unsupported or reversed complete-case inferences. Never update a registered protocol or silently replace a raw run. Save exploratory changes under a new round ID.
